selection_firewall.candidate_origin: mechanistic-class gap search; no predicted-versus-observed residual, chi, or ChemSA expectation was used to select or promote either trail

records.classification_basis: Both the primary kinetic literature and the independent computational study identify H2 addition to square-planar Ir(I) as oxidative addition; this family is mechanistically distinct from the frozen Pd/PCy3/PhBr oxidative-addition family.

barrier_quantity.type: PBE-D3/def2-SVP gas-phase electronic potential-energy activation barrier for H2 activation, evaluated as E(TS)-E(isolated Ir(I) complex)-E(H2)

source.authors: Pascal Friederich, Gabriel dos Passos Gomes, Riccardo De Bin, Alan Aspuru-Guzik, David Balcells
source.title: Machine learning dihydrogen activation in the chemical space surrounding Vaska's complex

barrier_quantity.typing_caveat: The source explicitly optimized geometries in the gas phase and defines the target as a potential-energy difference. This value may not be relabeled as a benzene-solution DeltaG-dagger, an experimental activation enthalpy, or a rate-derived activation quantity.

observed_comparator.type: direct experimental second-order H2 oxidative-addition rate constant

source.authors: Pwen Boon Chock and Jack Halpern
source.title: Kinetics of the Addition of Hydrogen, Oxygen, and Methyl Iodide to Some Square-Planar Iridium(I) Complexes
source.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society

observed_comparator.derived_quantity_quarantine: The 10.8 kcal/mol activation enthalpy and -23 eu activation entropy are rate-derived from the experimental kinetics and are retained only as descriptive provenance; they do not independently validate the rate.

condition_hold_basis: The computational barrier is an isolated gas-phase electronic potential-energy threshold with no reported solvent, zero-point, thermal, entropy, or solution-standard-state correction in the dataset barrier definition.
The observed comparator is a bimolecular rate constant measured in benzene solution at 303.15 K.
The frozen campaign rule requires medium and standard-state matching or an explicit defensible mapping; no such mapping is currently present.
Agreement with the experimental rate or activation parameters may not be used to choose a correction scheme or promote the candidate.
records.next_gate: Locate a barrier or activation free energy for the exact Vaska/H2 oxidative-addition event in benzene (or a quantitatively defensible solvent/standard-state mapping fixed independently of target agreement), with method choice not selected from residual quality.

records.classification_basis: The primary kinetic source explicitly identifies homogeneous molecular pyrolysis of ethyl chloride yielding ethylene and hydrogen chloride; this is a genuine elimination family distinct from the frozen ethoxyheterocycle ethylene-elimination family.

source.authors: K. A. Holbrook and A. R. W. Marsh
source.title: Unimolecular gas-phase pyrolysis of ethyl chloride

kinetics_first_comparator.mechanistic_evidence: unimolecular nature confirmed using inhibitor comparisons; experimental falloff was studied and a high-pressure rate expression was reconstructed

barrier_search_source.authors: Alexis Maldonado, Jose R. Mora, Tania Cordova, Gabriel Chuchani
barrier_search_source.title: Density functional theory calculations of the gas-phase elimination kinetics of 2-(dimethylamino)ethyl chloride and ethyl chloride
barrier_search_source.mechanism: four-centered cyclic transition state involving Cl, H, and the two carbon atoms

barrier_hold_basis: The accessible source record confirms an explicit ethyl-chloride theoretical comparison and transition-state topology but does not expose the full parent-compound numerical barrier table needed for exact quantity typing.

The 2010 paper discusses agreement with experimental activation values; before using any one functional/basis result, method selection must be audited to ensure the same target kinetics did not select the model.
The experimental Arrhenius activation energy may not be substituted for an independent theoretical barrier because it is derived from the target rate data.
records.next_gate: Recover the full 2010 barrier table or an alternative independently selected ab initio barrier source, type electronic/ZPE/thermal/free-energy terms exactly, then map only to the experimentally reconstructed high-pressure unimolecular regime.
